lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: Lots of laptops are coming to the desk today. Let's start learning hardware.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: A new decision is open: REPLACE PART. Use it only when the evidence shows physical damage.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: Loose or dusty parts just need fixing. Spare parts are expensive, don't swap them carelessly.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: Good. Your hands are getting used to a screwdriver. The scanner in the Tool Shop can help you read component health.
